_comment: Copy this file to  discord-app.json  and fill in your own values.
Creating it makes you the OWNER, which is the whole trick: the rpc.*
scopes are whitelist-only for public apps, but an owner may always
authorise their own application. So this app id works for you and
2. OAuth2 tab -> copy the Client ID, then Reset Secret and copy that.
3. OAuth2 -> Redirects -> add exactly  http://localhost  -> Save Changes.
It is never opened; it only has to match what the token exchange sends.
4. Put both values below, save as discord-app.json, restart node server.js.
5. Run the Discord DESKTOP app (the browser version has no local socket),
open the Discord widget, tap Link Discord and approve the popup.
Scopes requested: rpc, rpc.voice.read, rpc.voice.write, identify.
No bot, no server invite, no guild permissions - this is a local,
user-level authorisation. Both this file and discord-token.json are
refused by the web server and never reach the browser.
